name: @opencode-annotate/client
description: Browser client for selecting UI elements and sending annotations to OpenCode.

scripts.build: bun run build:module && bun run build:global && bun run build:types
scripts.build:module: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target browser --format esm --packages external
scripts.build:global: bun build src/global.ts --outfile dist/annotate.global.js --target browser --format iife
